text:
neel: Opening a small PR to refresh the Hello Breeze quickstart. Scope: tighten auth, add single-line curl + docker run first-deploy, clarify SDK v9 migration, and fix a pair of 301/404 links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/917
tara: great. can we keep the curl example one-line and add a tiny comment about expected JSON response? newbies like to know what to look for.
neel: yep 01keeping curl to one line and adding an "expected" note. planning order: curl -> JS async -> Python minimal -> docker run single line.
kevin: for v8->v9 migration call out renamed client import and the changed streaming API signature. small snippet is fine. also mention new env var name REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN and that REDWOOD_API_KEY is still accepted during the migration window.
neel: will add a Migration note: "REDWOOD_API_KEY supported; prefer REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN" and a tiny export example. also found a stale /guides/local link that redirects to /deploy/local-run  will update.
docs-bot: preview build started: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/917 (status: building) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
tara: tiny UX nit: prefer `export` for Unix shells and `powershell` example for Windows only if necessary. keep examples compact.
neel: changed to `export` and removed Windows to keep the page slim. curl example:```bash
export REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN=sk_live_... && curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/hello
# expected: {"message":"hello breeze"}
```
kevin: add docker run example pinned to `redwood/hello-breeze:0.1.0` and a one-liner health check.
neel: added Docker:```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN=$REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN -p 8080:8080 redwood/hello-breeze:0.1.0
# then: curl http://localhost:8080/health  # expected {"status":"ok"}
```
tara: can you also include a Troubleshooting mini-list for the common onboarding problems (401, port conflict, 502)? a quick 3-item checklist is perfect.
neel: added Troubleshooting: 1) verify token var 2) ensure port 8080 free 3) check outbound to api.redwood-inference.com. tiny log commands for docker/k8s included.
docs-bot: link-check: found 1 redirect -> auto-fixed in commit (sha: 9f7c1d) :white_check_mark:
kevin: small SDK nit: show JS async snippet using the new import: `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient` and a 5-line example for generate/stream. Python minimal after.
neel: added JS async (5 lines) and Python 2-line example. switched code fences to ```bash and ```js accordingly. squashed WIP commits. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/917 - requesting review from @tara @kevin
deploy-bot: preview redeployed for commit 9f7c1d (status: success) :white_check_mark:
tara: LGTM content-wise. please add a one-sentence callout near the top: "Use the redwood CLI for auth if you prefer interactive login" so readers know alternatives.
neel: added CLI callout and a link to the CLI auth page. squashed and updated PR description listing: auth, curl, docker, SDK migration, link fix, troubleshooting.
kevin: approving now. thanks for keeping it short and clear.
docs-bot: lint: passed; smoke tests: passed (sha: 9f7c1d) :white_check_mark:
neel: merged to main at 3812345910 b4b7 thanks all :tada:
